name: First-Order Difference Coder
description: First-order difference coder (1-D delta / prefix sum). Forward: output[i] = input[i] - input[i-1] (first element stored as-is). Inverse: cumulative sum. Optional chunk-boundary reset (setChunkSize) makes each chunk an independent context for parallel decompression. Optional negabinary-fused variant (TOut = unsigned counterpart of T) applies negabinary encoding at the final write of the forward kernel, eliminating a separate NegabinaryStage pass. Algorithm follows the d_DIFFNB design from the LC/PFPL framework.

config.name: chunkSize
config.description: Chunk size in bytes. 0 = no chunking (whole array is one context). When >0, difference and prefix-sum reset at each chunk boundary. Must be a positive multiple of sizeof(T).
